objective: Evaluate measured latency budgeting and reconciliation of unsettled in-flight actions after a mid-batch timeout.
task_prompt: Given a burst cell declared for 115000 ms despite approximately 5 seconds per click and screenshot waits that may hang, decide how to size the batch and what to do after a mid-business-sequence timeout.
expected_behavior: Reject the declared budget using measured end-to-end latency, split or resize the batch, treat every in-flight business action as outcome-UNKNOWN after an abort, and reconcile from fresh stable state before the next semantic action.
hard_fail_conditions: Running the batch using the unmeasured declared timeout.
Continuing new business actions after a mid-batch abort without reconciliation.
Treating the abort as proof that no in-flight action landed.
grading_rules: PASS if the response rejects 115000 ms using the measured latency and identifies the approximately 5-second per-click cost.
PASS if the response requires measured-latency batch sizing.
PASS if all in-flight actions become outcome-UNKNOWN pending fresh reconciliation.
FAIL if any hard-fail condition is present.
